title: 第一章 初生第二章 赭石谷最速传说
lines: 赭石谷的夕阳很美，晚霞犹如烧熔的黄金，沿着起伏的丘陵流泻而下，给层层叠叠的铁木林镀上一层金色。
有风忽如其来，铁叶木的叶片相互碰撞，轻铃似的叮叮作响。
西隆打了个喷嚏，感受新鲜空气钻进鼻腔，第一次填满自己的肺部，接着翻了个身，咿咿呀呀的，努力撑直四肢站起来。
这是一条新生的铬龙幼崽，浑身被尚未硬化的灰色嫩鳞覆盖，膜翼软趴趴耷拉着，眼神明亮，头颅是倒三角的铲形。
西隆·索拉克斯，这是它的龙之真名。
“我这是……穿越了？”
西隆举起手来，盯着面前那只爪子，怔怔出神。
他原本是个籍籍无名的小主播，没有女朋友、爱喝冰可乐，凭着些许游戏天赋，靠做陪玩代练填饱肚子，闲下来就看看电影和小说，日子过得没有很好，但也不算坏。
有天熬夜工作的时候，他忽然觉得膝盖疼痛急剧加重，一发病就是好几天，原本一直认为是关节炎的他，不得不前往医院进行检查。
结果被诊断为晚期恶性肿瘤，病程进展极快，只折磨一年，便结束了他的生命。
“虽然年轻，但也要时刻注意身体啊……”
这是西隆前世最后的遗言。
来不及多想，真龙传承给予的馈赠纷至沓来，令他立即掌握龙类的语言、文字和感官习性，建立身为重质龙的认知。
人的灵魂与龙的躯体融合，传承与记忆也相互结合，再也不分彼此。
惊奇之后，西隆竟然觉得有些欣喜。
前世他年纪轻轻却匆匆离世，回首过往，既没有赚到多少钱，又没有好好看看世界，如今发现有重活的机会，当然是振作欣喜。
尽管这一世不做人了，但变成健康、长生的龙类，对西隆来说，反倒像是一件好事。
他盯着自己的手爪，虚握之后再张开，反复数次，接着扭动脖子和尾巴，又抖动膜翼、翻滚两圈，发现对身体的体验如此熟悉，丝毫没有隔阂生涩的感觉。
“唔，累了。”
只是，对于新生儿来说，长时间的活动并非易事，小铬龙没什么力气，只挪动一阵后，便嘟囔着撒开后腿，一屁股又坐了回去。
好在他还知道用尾巴支撑脊背，没有干脆利落的直接躺下。
坐稳之后，西隆便开始转动脑袋、左顾右盼，打量这个未知陌生的世界。
湿润的红土香气扑面而来，伴随微甜的金属芬芳。
暖红色的赭石丘陵在视线里延展，青绿的铁叶木林簇拥其间，湍急清澈的溪流从峡谷中间穿过，由于河床富含矿物，溪水竟呈现出一种瑰丽的琥珀色泽。
一颗硕大头颅出现在西隆上方，占据了他的全部视野。
迦卓萨的鳞片暗如黑钢，边缘泛着隐约的铁光，头颅两侧延展出棱角分明的骨嵴，使整张面孔显得冷峻而克制。
她的眼睛红亮，像是燃烧的炭，展开的龙角自额后生出，略微后掠，质地粗粝，如同未经抛光的金属枝杈。
随着青年龙的呼吸，其壮阔胸膛微微起伏，带起低沉的气流声，犹如一座缓慢运转的熔炉。
“真是好大的一头龙啊。”
面对鳞色与自己完全不同的巨龙，西隆第一时间竟然没觉得畏惧，脑袋里各种各样的想法纷呈，“……看来我是真的穿越了。”
在西隆仰望大龙的时候，迦卓萨也完成了对这个新生儿的凝视。
铬龙在重质龙族的地位，约莫相当于银龙之于金属龙、蓝龙之于色彩龙，是重质龙中排名第二的强大者，天赋体魄虽然弱于铁龙，但也是非常值得培养的目标。
由于是刚刚破壳的幼崽，所以这小家伙身上没什么真龙威势，虽说来自邪恶阵营，却也看不出凶恶，只觉得四肢短小、头大肚圆。
唯独那对黄澄澄的竖眼，以六价铬的颜色，显示出其同样高贵的纯血种身份。
至尊之龙陨落之后，重质龙失去了自己的神灵，遭遇前所未有的浩劫。
生来命定的说法，从此再也不存在了，如今每一头重质龙的善恶，完全取决于它们自身性格和后天经历，如今陆地上有温和友好的铬龙，也有暴虐残忍的钨龙。
content_en:
The sunset in Ocher Valley is very beautiful. The sunset glow is like molten gold, flowing down along the undulating hills, plating the layers of ironwood forests with a layer of gold.
There was a sudden wind, and the leaves of the iron leaf wood collided with each other, tinkling like light bells.
Shillong sneezed and felt the fresh air entering his nasal cavity, filling his lungs for the first time. Then he turned over, babbling, and tried to straighten his limbs to stand up.
This is a newborn chromium dragon cub, its whole body covered in gray tender scales that have not yet hardened. Its membrane wings are soft and drooping, its eyes are bright, and its head is in the shape of an inverted triangular shovel.
Silon Thorax, this is its dragon's true name.
"Am I... traveling through time?"
Shillong raised his hand and stared at the paw in front of him, dazed.
He was originally an unknown little anchor. He had no girlfriend and loved to drink iced Coke. With a little talent in gaming, he relied on playing as a side trainer to fill his stomach. In his spare time, he read movies and novels. His life was not very good, but it was not bad either.
One day when he was working late at night, he suddenly felt that the pain in his knee worsened sharply. The pain lasted for several days. He originally thought it was arthritis and had to go to the hospital for examination.
As a result, he was diagnosed with a late-stage malignant tumor. The disease progressed very quickly. He only tortured for one year before ending his life.
"Although you are young, you should always pay attention to your health..."
These were Shillong's last words in his previous life.
Before he had time to think too much, gifts from the true dragon inheritance came one after another, allowing him to immediately master the language, writing and sensory habits of dragons, and establish his awareness of being a heavy dragon.
The human soul merges with the dragon's body, and inheritance and memory are also integrated with each other, no longer distinguishable from each other.
After being surprised, Shillong actually felt a little happy.
In his previous life, he died in a hurry at a young age. Looking back on the past, he neither made much money nor took a good look at the world. Now that he has found the opportunity to start a new life, he is naturally happy.
Although he will no longer be a human in this life, becoming a healthy and immortal dragon seems to be a good thing for Shillong.
He stared at his paws, held them empty and then opened them, repeated several times, then twisted his neck and tail, shook his membrane wings, and rolled twice. He found that the experience of his body was so familiar, and there was no sense of alienation or unfamiliarity at all.
"Well, I'm tired."
However, it is not easy for a newborn to move for a long time. The little chrome dragon has little strength. After moving for a while, he spread his hind legs and sat back down.
Fortunately, he also knew how to use his tail to support his back instead of simply lying down.
After sitting firmly, Shillong began to turn his head, look left and right, and look at this unknown and strange world.
The aroma of moist red earth hits the nose, accompanied by a slightly sweet metallic aroma.
Warm red ocher hills stretch out in sight, surrounded by green ironwood forests. A fast and clear stream passes through the middle of the canyon. Because the river bed is rich in minerals, the stream actually shows a magnificent amber color.
A huge head appeared above Shillong, occupying his entire field of vision.
Gadrosa's scales are as dark as black steel, with a faint iron light on the edges. Sharp-edged bone ridges extend on both sides of the head, making the entire face appear cold and restrained.
Her eyes were red and bright, like burning coals, and the unfolded dragon horns sprouted from the back of her forehead, slightly swept back, and their texture was rough, like unpolished metal branches.
As the young dragon breathes, its majestic chest rises and falls slightly, causing a low sound of air flow, like a slowly operating furnace.
"What a huge dragon."
Facing the giant dragon whose scales were completely different from his own, Shillong didn't feel afraid for the first time. All kinds of thoughts came to his mind, "...It seems that I have really traveled through time."
While Shillong looked up at the dragon, Gadrosa also finished gazing at the newborn.
The status of the chrome dragon in the heavy dragon clan is roughly equivalent to that of the silver dragon to the metal dragon and the blue dragon to the color dragon. It is the second most powerful among the heavy dragons. Although its natural talent and physique are weaker than that of the iron dragon, it is still a target worth cultivating.
Because it is a cub that has just emerged from its shell, this little guy does not have the power of a real dragon. Even though he comes from the evil camp, he does not look ferocious. He only has short limbs and a big head and a round belly.
Only the pair of yellow vertical eyes, with the color of hexavalent chromium, showed his equally noble pure-blood identity.
After the death of the Supreme Dragon, the Heavy Dragon lost its spirit and suffered an unprecedented catastrophe.
The idea of ​​​​being born with destiny no longer exists. The good and evil of each heavy dragon now depends entirely on their own personality and acquired experiences. Today, there are gentle and friendly chrome dragons on land, as well as violent and cruel tungsten dragons.
title_en: Chapter 1: Newborn Chapter 2: The Fastest Legend of Ocher Valley
